source_scope: All candidate serving measurements use clean212ebac. f6527dd only adds fatal-poll error observation/consumption plus regression tests; the full serving matrix has not been repeated on f6527dd. Do not infer final-head performance acceptance.
hardware: RTX5090 32GiB on45; GPU UUID, driver, compiler, effective release flags, model fingerprints and effective settings are in each hashed raw report.
method: Process pairs are independent clusters. Exact empirical median-ratio bootstrap for N<=5; 100000 deterministic draws (seed 20261025) for larger N. Pointwise 95% intervals, not a simultaneous SLO guarantee.
stability_note: Some observed process-pair ratios exceed the declared drift tolerance; no new stable baseline is issued and historical baseline IDs are unchanged.
independent_comparison_recomputation: All30 saved comparisons recomputed using tools/bench/compare-results.py; metrics, numeric result, token mismatches and point-estimate gate decision match exactly.
